1.consolidated_definition: Nombre con que se conoce la Universidad de Puerto Rico, formado con la pronunciación inglesa de las dos primeras letras de la sigla UPR (University of Puerto Rico).
1.en_consolidated_definition: The term commonly used to refer to the University of Puerto Rico, formed with the English pronunciation of the first two letters of the UPR acronym (University of Puerto Rico).
